command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0066/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All six 0.37.0 rows, twice each, twelve instructions and 44 bytes: the low rows are three bytes (8b 40 08 / 89 40 08), the REX.R and REX.B rows four (44/45 or 41 ...). This is the mod = 01 shape, so the ModRM byte is 40 + base and the signed disp8 follows at [16,8] or [24,8] behind a REX byte. Only %rsp/%r12 are excluded (SIB); %rbp/%r13 are ordinary bases here (8b 45 08), unlike at mod = 00. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 44-byte .text.
